title: Magic: The Gathering - BattleMage/Official Strategy Guide

paragraphs.text: The Official Strategy Guide for Magic: The Gathering - Battlemage is a strategy guide for the Magic: The Gathering - BattleMage game by Acclaim Entertainment . It was written by Mark Walker , and published in February 1997.

This is the only official strategy guide to the Magic: The Gathering "Battlemage" game. And not only for you, planeswalker . For there are others, fueled by 5,000 years of tireless rivalries and seething hatred. To defeat your opponents you'll require:
Mastery of the duels and the campaigns
Understanding of the five kinds of mana
Guidance with talking to the other Wizards
The resourceful planeswalker will utilize it . . . for the battles await.
